title: Chili's focuses on tech upgrades over AI for better service
excerpt: Chris Caldwell, CIO of Brinker, focuses on upgrading Chili's tech infrastructure instead of AI, enhancing service and financial performance.
content_html:
What AI? Chili's spends big on WiFi and tablets instead of tokens

By Alex Bitter

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Chris Caldwell is more focused on tablets these days than AI tokens.

The chief information officer of Chili's parent company, Brinker International, has spent his 2½ years in the role figuring out how to overhaul WiFi systems at restaurants and replace thousands of handheld devices that waitstaff use to take customers' orders, he told Business Insider.

Many restaurants are adding AI to their operations. At Starbucks and Burger King, for instance, AI agents are listening to drive-thru orders and fetching recipes for baristas.

Chili's, meanwhile, has largely stayed away from such uses. Instead, it's turned around its same-store sales in part by focusing on food quality, service, and, in Caldwell's case, replacing outdated tech systems.

"I'm not chasing AI to go, 'Guys, Anthropic just released a new LLM, and we need to use it because it's cool,'" he said.

From singing robots to new iPads

Before Caldwell arrived in 2024, Chili's was experimenting with lots of flashy technology, such as robots that could bus tables and sing Happy Birthday to diners.

As Caldwell talked to his new colleagues, though, he got the impression that Chili's needed to invest in more basic tech upgrades. Some restaurants didn't have enough ordering tablets, he said. When a tablet was available, Chili's system didn't reliably send customers' orders to the kitchen, resulting in slower service.

"The first thing I heard was that we're doing a lot of state-of-the-art things, but the foundational systems were really having some challenges," he said.

To fix these problems, Caldwell and colleagues invested in fixes such as 23,000 iPads for taking orders. It's also redesigning the software on those tablets to make taking orders as easy as using any other app — and help new employees train faster, he said.

Under Caldwell, Chili's has also replaced WiFi access points in all 1,200 of its US restaurants and made sure each had enough bandwidth so that ordering and other in-store operations weren't slowed down, he said.

Caldwell uses AI to brainstorm

It's not that Caldwell and Chili's are avoiding AI altogether.

Corporate employees at Brinker have access to Microsoft's Copilot — a tool that's made them "more efficient on a day-to-day basis," Caldwell said.

For example, Caldwell said that he bounces ideas off of AI. He described a conversation with the chatbot that helped him think through the implications of using payment devices stationed at Chili's tables instead of having customers flag down waitstaff to pay.

"I had probably a 30-minute brainstorming session with AI this morning just to make sure I'm thinking about that holistically," he said.

Brinker is also looking at about half a dozen uses of AI that could be more directly integrated into restaurant operations, such as estimating when customers' online orders will be ready for pick-up.

"Does it make life easier for our teams or customers?" he said. "That's the lens that we're using, for the most part."

Chili 母公司 Brinker International 的首席信息官在担任该职位 2.5 年的时间里，一直在研究如何彻底检修餐厅的 WiFi 系统，并更换服务员用来接受顾客订单的数千台手持设备，他告诉《商业内幕》。

许多餐厅正在将人工智能融入其运营中。 例如，在星巴克和汉堡王，人工智能代理正在监听得来速订单并为咖啡师获取食谱。

与此同时，Chili's 基本上避免了此类用途。 相反，它在一定程度上通过关注食品质量、服务以及更换过时的技术系统来扭转同店销售。

“我并不是在追求人工智能，‘伙计们，An​​thropic 刚刚发布了一个新的法学硕士，我们需要使用它，因为它很酷，’”他说。

从唱歌机器人到新 iPad

在考德威尔于 2024 年到来之前，Chili's 正在尝试许多华丽的技术，例如可以清理餐桌并向食客唱生日快乐歌的机器人。

然而，当考德威尔与他的新同事交谈时，他得到的印象是 Chili 需要投资于更基础的技术升级。 他说，一些餐馆没有足够的点餐平板电脑。 当平板电脑可用时，Chili 的系统无法可靠地将顾客的订单发送到厨房，从而导致服务速度变慢。

“我听到的第一件事是，我们正在做很多最先进的事情，但基础系统确实面临一些挑战，”他说。

为了解决这些问题，考德威尔和同事投资了 23,000 台 iPad 来接受订单。 他说，该公司还重新设计了这些平板电脑上的软件，使接受订单像使用任何其他应用程序一样简单，并帮助新员工更快地接受培训。

他说，在考德威尔的领导下，Chili's 还更换了其所有 1,200 家美国餐厅的 WiFi 接入点，并确保每家餐厅都有足够的带宽，以便点餐和其他店内业务不会减慢。

考德威尔使用人工智能进行头脑风暴

考德威尔和奇利并不是完全回避人工智能。

考德威尔说，Brinker 的公司员工可以使用微软的 Copilot，该工具使他们“日常工作更加高效”。

例如，考德威尔说他从人工智能中汲取灵感。 他描述了与聊天机器人的一次对话，这帮助他思考使用 Chili 餐桌上的支付设备而不是让顾客招呼服务员付款的影响。

“今天早上我可能与人工智能进行了 30 分钟的头脑风暴会议，只是为了确保我从整体上考虑这个问题，”他说。

Brinker 还在研究人工智能的六种用途，这些用途可以更直接地集成到餐厅运营中，例如估计顾客的在线订单何时可以提货。

“这会让我们的团队或客户的生活变得更轻松吗？” 他说。 “这就是我们大多数情况下使用的镜头。”
